design.name: 圣甲爆虫
design.brief: A chunky desert scarab beetle turned into a living bomb by the bandits: a round, high-domed sand-gold carapace with bronze-capped ridges and a few painted bandit spiral marks, a crimson cloth harness with leather straps binding a swollen, veined, glowing ember-orange powder sac onto its back (its weak spot) with a short lit fuse cord, a small armoured head with two glowing ember-orange eyes and a pair of curved dark mandibles, six stubby clawed legs with dark joints. Cute but menacing, readable as a beetle from any angle.
